children: Intelligent Bio Solutions completed a $5.0 million private placement with a single institutional investor, issuing 2,036,659 pre-funded warrants at a combined price of $2.455 per unit with accompanying Series N-1 and N-2 warrants. The company also entered a Registration Rights Agreement to file a resale registration statement by September 15, 2026 and target effectiveness by October 15, 2026. Ladenburg Thalmann served as placement agent, earning cash fees, expense reimbursement, and agent warrants equal to 5.0% of units sold. Proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.
